provenance.sportvu_source: NBA/STATS SportVU public 2015-16 release, github.com/linouk23/NBA-Player-Movements + mirrors (github.com/sealneaward/nba-movement-data, HF dcayton/nba_tracking_data_15_16)
provenance.license_note: derived data only; bulk dumps are never committed (see CLAUDE.md data rights)

definitions.sample: fixed-seed (20151027+year) uniform sample of halfcourt attempts
definitions.grid: 1ft bins over LOC_X [-250,250], LOC_Y [-50,420], tenths of feet
definitions.resolution.ra_origin_share: restricted-area shots filed at exactly (0,0) - the record declining to say where at the rim; drives the pin and the texture ladder
definitions.resolution.full_resolution_arenas: home arenas whose games recorded real rim coordinates that season; through 2009-10 only five or six did, and it follows the building, not the team
definitions.contemporaneous: 1996-97 only: mid-range recomputed under the 22-ft line then in force, against the modern polygons SHOT_ZONE_BASIC applies retroactively

contemporaneous.note: the 3PT line stood at 22 ft in 1994-97; SHOT_ZONE_BASIC applies the modern 23'9" geometry retroactively, filing these attempts as Mid-Range

seasons.note: shortened 3PT line era (1994-97); clean baseline starts 1997-98
lockout season (50 games per team) - short, not sparse
lockout season (66 games per team) - short, not sparse
1,229 games, not 1,230: BOS@IND (Apr 16, 2013) cancelled after the Boston Marathon bombing, never replayed - the record is complete
